facts.fact: A steering committee of Sonatrach, the agriculture ministry, BNEDER and ENSA was installed, per ENSA, to monitor 30-hectare agricultural pivots using satellite observations alongside sensor measurements and field observations.

systems.system: Comite de pilotage for 30-hectare agricultural pivots
systems.owner: Sonatrach (Agroalimentaire Activites), ministry of agriculture, BNEDER, ENSA
